segments.text: Thanks for joining. We need to settle the Northwind commercial proposal today.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: The pilot showed forty active seats across three teams.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The support queue averaged six requests per week during the trial.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: What is the purchasing ceiling on their side?
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Their procurement lead can approve up to twenty thousand dollars this quarter.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Anything above that goes to the finance committee in November.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Our draft was twelve thousand dollars per year for the platform.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: That is acceptable if onboarding is included and there is no surprise setup fee.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The old draft listed two thousand dollars for migration services.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Remove that separate fee; onboarding and the first data import are included.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Do we keep a cap on archived projects?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: No cap for the first year, provided storage stays under five terabytes.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Put the storage condition in plain language in the order form.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Their legal team wants a thirty day exit window after renewal notice.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: We can offer that without changing the twelve month term.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The renewal notice should go out sixty days before the term ends.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Northwind also asked whether the price rises with each new seat.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The quote covers fifty seats, then additional seats cost eight dollars monthly.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Let us state the included fifty seats explicitly.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Can we keep the pilot workspace alive while procurement signs?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Yes, through August fifteen, with read-only access after that.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I will send the revised order form by Friday.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: I will check the wording with Priya in legal.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I will update the usage estimate for storage.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: One more point: the security review is separate from price approval.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Their security lead expects our pen test summary next Tuesday.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: We already have the summary from the June audit.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Send only the summary, not the full report.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: I will schedule a call with procurement for next week.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The contract should name Northwind as the billing entity.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Agreed. Twelve thousand annually, fifty seats, and onboarding included.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: I will record those terms in the follow-up email.
segments.speaker: remote
